name: DGi
title: dgintel.ai
shortDescription: DGi, powered by Datagran, is a revolutionary AI-driven data platform that enables users to build workflows, code, and BI dashboards without traditional backend or frontend structures. It's designed for data professionals and businesses looking to integrate and automate their data processes efficiently. Users can connect to databases, filter data, schedule jobs, and even create and share custom dashboards.
pros: Fully AI-driven with no need for backend or frontend
Flexible data workflows and automation capabilities
Interactive UI generated on-demand for various tasks
cons: May require technical knowledge to fully utilize
Experimental nature might pose reliability issues
Limited information on security and compliance
